request.spec: Let me filter projects by active, on hold or finished.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read CLAUDE.md — it states the working rules, the project layout, and the data-testid
conventions. Follow it.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Let me filter projects by active, on hold or finished.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, and any audit records it
expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as you work;
iterate until it passes. Implement the full-stack change (database migration + OfficeFloor
server + front-end). Do NOT edit the pinned scaffolding (bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop,
bin/e2e, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The test passes.

The change was a thin front-end addition — the backend already carried project `status` (migration `V21`, seed support, and `ProjectsGetLogic` all served it). I added:

1. **`features/projects/statusFilter.slot.tsx`** — a new self-contained toolbar control (`data-testid="project-status-filter"`) that owns a `projectStatus` URL search param, offering All / Active / On hold / Finished. It fills the existing `ProjectsToolbar` slot (order 30, after the tag filter).

2. **`features/projects/ProjectList.tsx`** — reads the same `projectStatus` key and adds one filter clause, mirroring how the list already filters by tag and archived state. The two features share only the URL key, no import.

`npm run typecheck` and `bin/e2e` both pass.
